input.summary: Keep the ball in the upper playfield and use the lit bumper to build bonus. Collect Double Bonus at the upper-right saucer. Shoot drop targets only when their rebounds are safe.

quickInfo.name: Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Each drop target and each hit on the lit bumper advances bonus by 1K toward its 20K maximum.

quickInfo.name: Bumper lights
quickInfo.summary: Ten-point switches change the bumper lamps, while an unlit bumper hit lights that bumper for later bonus advances.

quickInfo.name: Double Bonus saucer
quickInfo.summary: The upper-right saucer doubles the built bonus when its lamp is lit.

quickInfo.name: Drop bank
quickInfo.summary: Each of the nine drops scores 500 and adds 1K bonus, while the full bank adds 5,000 and 5K bonus.

quickInfo.name: Upper flippers
quickInfo.summary: The upper flippers can deflect a descending ball to the opposite lower flipper or return it toward the top.

steps.text: Plunge to the top. Identify the lit bumper and watch the feed around both upper flippers.
Keep the ball in upper play. Hit the lit bumper for 1K bonus advances.
Let safe or incidental drop-target hits add bonus. Do not force a direct bank shot.
When the upper-right saucer lights, send the ball back to the top and collect Double Bonus.
modeNotes: Double Bonus: Build bonus to the operator-set threshold. Then put the ball in the lit upper-right saucer to double the end-of-ball collect.

steps.text: Continue lit-bumper and safe-drop progress until bonus reaches 20K.
After 20K and Double Bonus are ready, use upper-flipper deflections and safer top play to protect the 40K collect.

fallback.title: Lit-bumper bonus
fallback.when: Use this when drop-target rebounds are reaching the outlanes or center drain.

steps.text: Return the ball to the upper playfield.
Use ten-point switches to manage the bumper lights.
Hit the lit bumper for bonus advances.
Collect the upper-right Double Bonus saucer when it lights.

alternatives.title: Controlled drop-bank clear
alternatives.when: Use this when the target rebounds return safely and several drops remain reachable.

steps.text: Choose a drop target that gives a shallow, recoverable rebound.
Use each target for 500 points and a 1K bonus advance.
Complete all nine for 5,000 points and 5K bonus.
Stop after the bank stays down. Resume top play until the next ball.
Advance bonus with the lit bumper and safe drop targets.
Reach the operator-set threshold for the upper-right saucer.
Collect Double Bonus at the saucer.
Carry the 40K maximum bonus to the end of the ball.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper deflection
techniques.instruction: Leave the upper flipper down when the ball will reach the same-side lower flipper. Hold it up to send the ball toward the opposite lower flipper.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper top return
techniques.instruction: Use an upper flipper to return the ball toward the top instead of shooting across the drop bank when the side feed is unsafe.

cautions.issue: Upper-flipper shots at the drop bank create fast side-to-side movement and can drain at either side.
cautions.response: Use the upper flippers for controlled deflections or top returns when the cross-playfield shot is unsafe.

cautions.issue: Shooting the drops from a lower flipper can return the ball through the center or toward an outlane.
cautions.response: Test one target from control. Switch to the lit-bumper route after a dangerous rebound.

cautions.issue: A ball leaving the top can pass the upper flippers and drain through the center.
cautions.response: Watch the rubber above the upper flippers. Flip only when a passive deflection will not reach a lower flipper.

checkBeforePlay: Read the adjustable 4K-13K bonus threshold that lights Double Bonus and Extra Ball.
Confirm ball count plus Extra Ball, Special, and replay treatment before choosing a secondary award.
Test tilt, posts, bumper strength, both upper-flipper feeds, and the upper-right saucer eject before committing to top play.
